notes.title: Workshop BETA
notes.content:
[img]https://40.media.tumblr.com/c7c3a0d4ac8c119900f82f95de221dd6/tumblr_njscek9myR1t7z64po1_540.png[/img]

Starting from today there is the opportunity to use the Steam Workshop to translate the game "Antisquad" into your language. 

This option is still in beta testing stage and will be released after that stage on the open access.

To be able to use the translation files and tools to upload them into workshop, you need the following:
[olist]
[*] Have a copy of the game and the computer with the Windows operating system
[*] Add me  ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/support_insgames]Rose[/url]) as a friend and write in the thread ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/268200/discussions/5/611698195160005648/]link[/url]) that you wish to participate in the testing.
[*] Wait for the access code for the version of the game having the support of the translation and for the access to files with a partial translation into German, French, Italian and Spanish
[*] Follow the instructions in the thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/268200/discussions/5/611698195160005648/]link[/url]
[/olist]

notes.title: New DLC Available
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/335981/extras/Facebook_Patch_Poster_Cactus_update+DLC_1_Tactics_small.jpg?t=1419270476[/img]

Today, after you update the game, a new game mode will be available for you. 

[b]What exactly are waiting for you? [/b]

4 sets of missions in the same environment as the main game: 
[olist]
[*] Events in Mexico when one of the characters was captured by drug mafia; 
[*] Events in Mexico during an operation against drug mafia; 
[*] Events in North Korea; 
[*] Events near the coast of Somalia during the protection of the cargo vessel. 
[/olist]

Each set consists of 12 missions. Some of these may be familiar to you, and some are brand new. 

Every mission is a tactical puzzle. You will be placed to certain conditions. In spite of this you should win with what you have available. After completing a puzzle, you will proceed to the next one, and so on. 

In addition, some new details will be added to the storyline for the main game. 

The new mode is isolated from the main game, and progress in one of them will not affect the progress in the other. 

Enjoy the game!


http://store.steampowered.com/app/335981

http://store.steampowered.com/app/335982

The new mode is isolated from the main game, and progress in one of them will not affect the progress in the other.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Antisquad new update 1.6 for Steam!!!
notes.content:
What's new in Steam version update 1.6:


[h1]Game mechanics: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] The system of bonuses coming from the weapons and the equipment as well as the parameters of the characters upgrade have been adjusted ; 
[*] The behavior of enemies and bosses on missions have been finalized. The responses to the attacks has been added to the bosses. Parameters of health and armor as well as the action points for some units have been adjusted.
[*] The 'casual' difficulty have been removed. 
[*] The balance has been changed for some missions. 
[*] The tutorial has been corrected.
[/olist]

[h1]Items: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] New items have been added: a stun gun, a canister of gasoline, a radio-controlled mine. These items can be found in the chest or you can open an access in the store
[/olist]

[h1]Rewards and prices: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] The prices of items, upgrades of characters, weapons and equipment have been corrected. 
[*] The possibility of non-consecutive completing the campaign (opening them for coins) have been removed.
[*] The rewards for killing enemies have been increased, extra rewards for missions have been removed. 
[*] The rewards coming from chests have been increased.
[/olist]

[h1]Challenges and achievements:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Several new challenges and achievements have been added. They can be obtained in the next versions of the game.
[*] The achievements to perform challenges, to the ejection of chests and some other have been fixed.
[*] The duplicate window of the achievements have been removed.
[/olist]

[h1]Graphics and performance: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] The shadows on most missions have been corrected for greater realism. 
[*] Graphic issues on some missions as well as known graphic issues with the bosses have been fixed. 
[*] The available graphics modes have been optimized. 
[*] The memory consumption during the game has been optimized. 
[*] Lags in the interface have been fixed.
[/olist]

[h1]Artwork:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] A graphical introduction in the form of comic books, telling the background of the first campaign, has been added to the game.
[*] The resolution of artistic splash screens in the game have been increased.
[*] Some badges on Steam have been redrawn.
[/olist]

[h1]Social networks:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] The ability to connect your Twitter account to the game has been added.
[*] Bugs occurring when someone tries to login to Facebook or send a message have been fixed.
[*] Bugs with the issuance of the additional coins after the posts to the social network have been fixed.
[/olist]

[h1]Controls:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] A new settings screen for remapping keys to the game have been added.
[*] The functionality of the right mouse button has been increased, namely, now there are the information about a character or an enemy, pop-up information window about an active ability or item and the behaviour similar to "back" button in other cases.
[*] The additional buttons to select during the game the items, the special attack or the special ability have been added.
[*] The size of the game cursor has been reduced.
[/olist]

[h1]User interface:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] The interface of character's upgrade has been corrected: the representation of parameters to be upgraded is more accurate now, the unnecessary elements have been removed.
[*] The interface of the equipment by arms and ammunition has been corrected: the unnecessary elements have been removed.
[*] The interface of the items has been corrected: a large section for the purchase and transformation of items has been added.
[/olist]

Download, play, stay tuned and the advent of new content! 
You can find out first about a new update and the features on [url=www.antisquad.com]our website[/url] or [url=www.vk.com/antisquadgame] the official website of the game in the VK[/url] and [url=www.facebook.com/Antisquad]Facebook[/url]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Antisquad
notes.content:
Antisquad is Now Available on Steam!

Widely known in small circles as AntiSquad, they are a military tactical response unit. These hardened military professionals, tired of bureaucracy, politics and serving the armed forces, have established a private paramilitary formation located in south United States. Being true military professionals, they periodically execute contracts for jobs that may not be considered “clean”.

The Team consists of many complex individuals with their own back story, but they do not shun mercenary applicants. Members of the team are idealists; they dwell on moral issues, as well as question blind nationalism, etc. AntiSquad strongly differ from military units. They truly are a bunch of contradictions put together - heartfelt cynics, gregarious egoists, aggressive pacifists, and phlegmatic rebels all under one banner.
